iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 49. MIXED: Iran nuclear chief Eslami rules out ANY enrichment restrictions (Euronews/AP Apr 9) - says enrichment right 'necessary' for talks. BUT: Reuters reports Iran indicated willingness to turn over enriched uranium (White House). CNN: US/Israel determined to wipe out nuclear expertise. 10-point plan demands US accept enrichment + lift sanctions. Ceasefire fragile but holding. Rhetoric: HIGH (up from medium). Diplomatic: HIGH. Technical: CRITICAL unchanged. Probability DOWN to 34%. Falling.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 49. CRITICAL: Strait of Hormuz ship traffic at STANDSTILL despite ceasefire (ABC News Apr 9). Trump threatens 'bigger, better and stronger' attacks unless 'real agreement' reached. 20,000 sailors stranded. Iranian mines continue to threaten shipping (5,000+ arsenal per NYT). Australia joining Hormuz security talks. Oil crisis deepening - CRS report confirms global impact. Rhetoric: CRITICAL (up from high). Mobilization: CRITICAL. Diplomatic: LOW. Probability UP to 40%. Rising.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel–Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 49. VOLATILE: Ceasefire threatened as Israel expands Lebanon strikes (AP Apr 8). Netanyahu authorizes direct talks with Lebanon (AP Apr 9) - first diplomatic opening. BUT Lebanese official says 'no negotiations under fire.' Hezbollah paused attacks under ceasefire (Reuters). 1,500+ killed, 1M displaced. Iran closed Hormuz again in response to Lebanon strikes. Diplomatic opening slightly lowers probability. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Diplomatic: MEDIUM. Probability DOWN to 62%. Falling.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: OSW analysis confirms Turkey pursuing strategic ambiguity on nuclear weapons. FM Fidan: Iran ambitions could push Turkey into nuclear arms race. NATO Steadfast Dart-2026 ongoing. Journal Neo: Ankara cooperating with Pakistan on nuclear tech. Akkuyu nuclear plant commissioning. Times of Israel warns Turkish nuclear weapon risk. Stable at 11%.

india.name: India–Pakistan
india.notes: ESCALATORY: India-Pakistan exchange nuclear sites list amid tensions (Savera). CFR report warns renewed armed conflict in 2026 due to 'heightened terrorist activity.' Carnegie: analysis of nuclear noise and signaling patterns. Al Jazeera: full war would be first between two nuclear-armed nations. US Annual Threat Assessment: relations 'remain at risk of nuclear conflict.' Rhetoric: HIGH. Diplomatic: LOW. Probability UP to 25%. Rising.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 49. Iran war = strategic windfall for Russia (Axios/WaPo/Zakaria): surging oil, diverted Western attention, strained NATO. Russia openly reveling in Trump's NATO attacks. Oil prices + sanctions easing 'pumping billions into Russia war chest.' Axios: without US Article 5 commitment, NATO 'significantly undermined.' New START expired Feb 2026, no replacement. Strategic Rocket Forces 90% modernized. Probability stable at 56%.

china.name: China
china.notes: ESCALATING: ISW China-Taiwan Update Apr 3 confirms ongoing PLA activity. Taiwan Warns of China Hybrid Tactics (Apr 8). KMT Chairwoman Cheng Li-wun Beijing visit. Taiwan military: budget delay threatens $2.4B weapons buying + F-16 training (Reuters). CNN: China secretly expanding nuclear weapons infrastructure. CCP Professor Jin Canrong suggests boarding weapons ships to Taiwan. PLA 2026 combat training across all forces. Technical: CRITICAL. Mobilization: HIGH. Probability UP to 16%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: 3 DAYS of major weapon tests (Apr 7-9) - multiple SRBMs from Wonsan, 240km each (Euronews/NK News/AP/Boston25/Politico). Kim observed upgraded solid-fuel engine test. VP FM Jang Kum-chol: South Korea 'most hostile enemy state.' Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Kim demands US nuclear recognition. 38 North: solid-propellant ICBM, tactical nukes, LACMs all deployed. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Technical: CRITICAL. Probability UP to 89%. Rising.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia–Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1140+. Russia concocting Ukrainian bomb claims - potential pretext for nuclear escalation (confirmed by ACA). Kremlin warns of potential threat of Ukraine acquiring nuclear weapons. Iran war diverting Western attention from Ukraine. New START expired Feb 2026, no replacement. GCRI nuclear war analysis published. Bulletin Doomsday Clock: nuclear risk continued in third year of war. PBS experts debate extending nuclear arms treaty. Probability stable at 80%.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS CONTINUE: China-hosted Urumqi talks confirmed (NPR/Bloomberg/Al Jazeera/AP). Both sides committed to ceasefire. China FM spokesperson Mao Ning: actively mediating. Sporadic mortar incidents continue (Kunar border) but ceasefire largely holding. Taliban abandoned some border posts. Earlier Qatar/Turkey rounds precede China talks. Diplomatic: HIGH. Probability DOWN to 6%. Falling.
